facts.difficulty: 4 out of 10 (PowerPyx, as reported by multiple guides)
facts.missable: Possibly 1: Positive Mental Attitude (meditate at every spot)
facts.online: 0 online trophies — every trophy is offline single-player
facts.playthroughs: One playthrough is enough — no difficulty settings, no online trophies, no New Game+
facts.time: About 200 hours (PowerPyx); Push Square puts it at 250–300 hours or more

advice: Start in Chapter 1: meditate at every spot you find, in every area you reach.
Do not leave a region's spots for later — a spot may stop being available as the story moves on.
Use both characters at each spot where the game allows it.
Everything else on the list can be earned after the story in free roam, so this is the single trophy that needs care during the playthrough.
missables.safeNote: Every other trophy is safe: story trophies pop as you play, stranger strands and activities stay open after the final mission, and the 100% checklist counts earlier progress. One playthrough is enough.
missables.title: The one trophy that might be missable
missables.warning: Positive Mental Attitude — meditate at every spot across Leonida — is the only trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable, and the only one with any missable warning in the early guides. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, and both Jason and Lucia must meditate at them.

stages.summary: Chapters 1–4 and the final mission, plus the named story missions. This is the only stage with a missable risk, so fold the meditation spots into your route from Chapter 1.
stages.tip: Whenever you reach a new area, look for meditation spots first. There are 18 spots in 10 locations and both Jason and Lucia must meditate — do not leave a region's spots for later.
stages.title: Play the story — and meditate as you go

stages.summary: Eight stranger mission strands across Leonida, including the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. These can be finished after the story, but start them as they appear so the map stays busy.
stages.tip: Only some stranger questlines count toward the eight for Strangers & Freaks, and early guides are still confirming which — finish every strand you find.
stages.title: Stranger strands and character finales

stages.summary: The skill grind: 42 Shooting Range golds, 250 stunts, 20 race wins, drone races at all 14 locations, fishing against Cal, the arcade, hunting for Bret and 50 of the 80 challenges.
stages.tip: Do the shooting range early — gold medals take practice. Stunts and challenges stack with exploring, so let this stage overlap with stage 5.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.summary: Bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, shop robberies with your partner, illegal operations for every gang, Combat Focus takedowns and laundering $250,000 in Marked Bills.
stages.tip: Bank vaults open after an optional Chapter 4 mission and each one brings a 4-star wanted level — plan the getaway before you crack the vault. Launder marked bills after every score.
stages.title: Crime, cash and your partner

stages.summary: Three of 18 card sets, WAiNK scans at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, all 8 garages, $100,000 spent, and every corner of the state explored.
stages.tip: Work region by region: scan WAiNK spots, discover vehicles and hunt cards in one sweep instead of criss-crossing the map five times.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploring Leonida

stages.summary: The in-game 100% checklist opens after the story and counts progress made earlier. Finish its remaining items — 300 stunts and 70 challenges among them — and A Long Road pops, followed at once by the platinum.
stages.tip: Open the checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) as soon as the story ends and work it top to bottom. Nothing on it is missable.
stages.title: 100% completion, then the platinum

stages.summary: The cryptic ones: a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a showroom smash, bowling, a story choice, a second attempt, a strange encounter and a melee drive-by. Their descriptions point at the deed, but early guides have not confirmed the exact triggers yet — this guide flags them Unconfirmed rather than guessing, so work through them alongside the other stages and check the guides as they are confirmed.
stages.tip: Do not grind these blind. Try what each description suggests once, move on, and come back when the method is confirmed — none of them is missable.
stages.title: Side moments and secrets
